description: List public IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card topics from the Youshow IELTS speaking question bank. Returns the cue card prompts, the points to cover and related Part 3 questions, in English or Chinese.

limit.description: Number of cue cards to return. Defaults to 5, capped at 10.

locale.description: Language of the cue card content. Defaults to zh.
